respuesta.razonamiento: The architecture shows Owkin (Kinai)'s medical imaging and AI training pipeline. Medical images (5 TB per project) from biologists/pathologists and hospitals are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. Amazon EKS hosts the platform where pathologists annotate and label images. The enriched data is sent to Amazon SageMaker to train machine learning models, leveraging Amazon FSx for high I/O performance and AWS IAM for security and regulatory compliance (such as HDS certification). The trained model is stored in a second S3 bucket, which exports models and results back to Amazon EKS for validation and inference.
respuesta.nombre: Kinai Medical Image Analysis and Model Training Architecture
